title: Champions from 13 countries vie for supremacy in Red Bull Half Court World Finals
summary: The Philippines will host the 2026 Red Bull Half Court World Finals on Dec. 5, bringing national champions from 13 countries to Manila for the global 3-on-3 basketball tournament.
